finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panels on the provisioned `Service health` dashboard (found at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), exactly as shown: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"** (3 panels, flat layout, no rows/tabs).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr30-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr30-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query row header shows "(TestData)", data source picker shows the TestData logo; panel rendered values like 86.2 / 88.9). "Dashboard saved" toast observed.

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr30-n1 Notes"** with content **"Bench notes for run fwgr30-n1"** (includes the runid), rendered on the dashboard and saved ("Dashboard saved" toast observed).

**4. DONE** — Dashboard has the tag **"bench"** (visible in the Dashboards browse list Tags cell and in the exported dashboard JSON as `"tags": ["bench"]`), and its time range is **Last 6 hours**, persisted into the saved dashboard: the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** checkbox was ticked before saving, and the saved JSON model contains `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`. A reload with a bare URL still shows "Last 6 hours".

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **1m** and persisted: the save drawer's **"Update default refresh value"** checkbox was ticked (creating a diff of `+ "refresh": "1m"`), Save succeeded with the "Dashboard saved" toast, the saved JSON model contains `"refresh": "1m"`, and reloading the dashboard from a URL without a refresh parameter caused Grafana to rewrite it to `...&refresh=1m` with the top-bar picker reading "1m".

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser's page URL (window.location.href) after a fresh navigation:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efy2tbqqh3dhcd/fwgr30-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **efy2tbqqh3dhcd**.
